About

I am a Finance student at Bina Nusantara University with a focus on equity research. Through national and international competitions and my role in the university's finance club, I take listed companies from annual reports and market data to a full valuation model, a written research report, and an investment pitch before industry judges.

My research is grounded in accounting. I have prepared journals and financial statements for a small business and spent a year teaching more than 80 students accounting, auditing, and ERP software as an assistant lecturer. That foundation shapes how I read financial statements before forming a view on valuation.
